--- clean.sv
+++ buggy.sv
@@ -12,7 +12,7 @@
 			begin 
 				match <= 1'b0;
 			end
-		else if (a_tem == 8'b0111_0001)
+		else if ((a_tem == 8'b0111_0001) && (a_tem[0] == 1'b1))
 			begin
 				match <= 1'b1;
 			end

claims.violated_requirement: The output match should be asserted when the shift register matches 8'b0111_0001, but the mutated condition requires an additional check on the LSB. This will fail when the pattern is matched but the LSB is 0.
claims.spec_basis: The spec states 'The output match should be asserted (logic 1) whenever the value of the shift register a_tem matches the specific 8-bit pattern 8'b0111_0001' without additional conditions.

grammar_error: Syntax-token insertion/deletion is forbidden. Replace at most two existing operands/operators, or swap one existing two-operand concatenation. Do not append an if guard.
